---
title: "DEGinsight revised benchmark"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
folder <- file.path(Sys.getenv("DEGINSIGHT_BENCH_DIR", "revised"), "scores")
read_scores <- function(file) {
  path <- file.path(folder, file)
  if (file.exists(path)) read.csv(path) else NULL
}
```

## Differential expression and ORA baselines

The tables report separate mixed, upregulated and downregulated analyses
based on adjusted P < 0.05 and absolute log2 fold change > 1. The expected
terms are mapped to the supplied GMT collection.

```{r results='asis'}
ora <- read_scores("baseline_ora.csv")
if (is.null(ora)) {
  cat("Run `Rscript benchmark/run_all.R` from the repository root.")
} else {
  for (direction in c("mixed", "up", "down")) {
    cat("\n\n### ", direction, "\n\n", sep = "")
    rows <- ora[ora$direction == direction, ]
    print(knitr::kable(rows[c("dataset", "residual_df", "n_tested", "n_degs",
                             "pathways_fdr_0_05", "expected_at_5",
                             "expected_at_10", "expected_at_20", "n_expected")]))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Model and ablation coverage

```{r results='asis'}
for (kind in c("results", "ablation")) {
  results <- read_scores(paste0(kind, "_summary.csv"))
  cat("\n\n### ", kind, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (is.null(results)) {
    cat("No live response has been scored under the revised protocol.\n")
  } else {
    cat(sum(results$status == "completed"), " live responses scored.\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(results[c("dataset", "model", "status", "few_shot", "top_n",
      "tissue", "recovery_keyword", "recovery_judge", "expected_cited",
      "expected_in_ora_at_same_budget", "expected_in_prompt",
      "unrecognized_pathway_rate", "n_unsupported_drivers")]))
  }
}
```
